rows.grounds: sandhi fusion of siddhisaṃprāptiḥ (siddhi+saṃprāpti, attainment of powers) and mūlakaulam (mūla+kaula, root Kaula); predicate nominal

items.question: What is identified as the root Kaula that brings attainment of the eight powers?
premises: The eight powers are under consideration.
Attainment of these powers is linked to the root Kaula.
items.inference: The root Kaula is declared to be the means for attaining the eight powers.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight powers is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And, O fair-faced one, the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula.
